principle: One theme object (night-court-production-hybrid) resolved by one resolver into four scopes; the light presentation is a change to the shared arena tokens, not page-level patches. No second design system, no new dependency, no new serverless function.

sources.resolver: src/theme/themeResolver.js (brandHeaderTokens now frozen master-brand constants, independent of the arena palette)
sources.generated: src/theme/basketball-themes.css via npm run theme:css (pinned in sync by ui:night-court-contracts)

rules: Solid gold fills carry cta-ink and use cta-mid, never text-grade gold.
Text-grade gold/blue are darkened for AA on ivory; hue preserved (Team Gold 36–50°, Team Blue 200–230°).
Hard-coded night literals in index.css were replaced by tokens or color-mix over --ec-a-bg; the two remaining rgba(3,7,13) values are fallbacks inside var().
Editorial, reading and lobby scopes are unchanged (they were already ivory/ink).
